spanish: Y esto lo que harás sobre el altar: corderos hijos de año dos al día, siempre.

findings.issue: Masculine dual “two” counts the masculine plural lambs; after singular “año” it reads as two years, so the lambs lose that count and the year gains it.
תמיד is a singular noun of continuity; “siempre” is adverbial smoothing that keeps that sense.

notes: The other tokens keep 2ms qal, the altar, singular year, and ל plus the day.
